messages.text:
Your cancelled card does not stop the refund. If approved, it goes to the order’s original payment; the card issuer handles the credit, and we can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment; refund-policy/v2/payout).

I’ve proposed **BRL 55.00** for the rug. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card. A staff member will then review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
